args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: the dull heavy impact of a round wooden shield slammed into an enemy: a short flat vertical impact flash shaped like a thick crescent on the right side (pale warm white core, grey-steel edge, no gold), a few chunky wood splinters and small iron flecks bursting outward, a ring of grey dust puffs pushed out sideways at chest height, short thick motion strokes. Physical and grounded, no magic, no runes, no glowing barrier. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference swamp monster: solid parts (rock, mud, metal shards) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing energy parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur. Layered composition: a bright core shape, secondary shapes, and small scattered particles. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no creatures, no weapons, no shields, no text, no letters, transparent background.
